body: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. summaryZh: 使用 Planning-Grounding Agent 进行在线密集强化学习，用于实时 iOS 应用程序上的 UI 导航。虽然前沿视觉语言模型在用户界面 (UI) 导航方面展示了强大的功能，但其较高的推理成本阻碍了日常使用。相反，通过监督微调（SFT）或离线强化学习训练的较小模型通常会记住静态轨迹，导致执行脆弱且无法从错误中恢复。
